items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: He and Andy Gibson and Billy Moore, Jr., William Moore, Jr. Oh, and there was another guy by the name of Bud Estes who -- they were all writing for the band.

ctx.x: Oh, a whole bunch -- well, let's see, Billy Byers, Bill Holman, and -- well, they did the majority of them. And of course there's a montage there that was really a collection of parts out of different arrangements, you know. Andy Gibson, William Moore, Jr., and Billy May. And then there's -- let's see, there's, "Jeeps Blues," on there, the original Ellington arrangement, with Willy Smith doing it this time. And Clarke Terry does his Mumbles with the big band.
Gee, that would be great to see and hear here.
